text:
evan (eng-runtime): FYI — after the vuln triage this morning we need a small-batch base image rebuild + cosign signing. planning a canary rollout (5% -> 25%)

mira (eng-security): which CVE triggered this? do we have repro or exploit telemetry?

ev an (eng-runtime): CVE-2026-0452 in glibc shim libs. exploit is low reliability but PoC exists. no active customer impact reported, just proactive.

mira (eng-security): ok. two immediate asks: (1) KMS key for signing (customer-managed if possible) (2) RBAC change so infra-builds SA can call cosign/signing pipeline. also want audit logs to include cosign attestations.

deepak (eng-infra): KMS rotation window is next Tue but we can provision a temporary key alias: aws kms create-key + create-alias. we can give the infra-builds role kms:Sign on that key.

linda (oncall): timeline? if we do canary 5% now -> 25% in 2h -> full in 24h, what are rollback steps if instability?

ev an (eng-runtime): plan: build numbered images: base-v2.{canary,release}. push to staging registries, cosign sign with key alias `alias/rebuild-3891-temp`. canary traffic via router weight. rollback = remove signed tag and route weight back. if runtime crashes, immediate weight=0 and manual pod restart.

mira (eng-security): audit retention — current SIEM retention is 90d. for this signing/audit we need 13 months. can we hook cosign attestations to our S3 bucket + CloudTrail?

deepak (eng-infra): yes. we'll enable CloudTrail data events for ECR and S3 and forward to SIEM. action: I'll add an IAM policy for the infra-builds role. snippet:

```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name infra-builds --policy-name CosignKmsPolicy --policy-document '{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["kms:Sign","kms:GetPublicKey"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_TEMP_KEY"
  }]
}'
```

mira (eng-security): also need kubernetes RBAC for the build controller to read image attestations in the attestation namespace. deepak can you add a RoleBinding?

deepak (eng-infra): yep. kubectl snippet:

```
kubectl create rolebinding build-controller-attest-reader -n attestation --role=attestation-reader --serviceaccount=infra:build-controller
```

linda (oncall): who owns the incident timeline comms if we detect regressions?

ev an (eng-runtime): I'll own canary monitoring. mira you own security signals (SIEM/IDS alerts). deepak you own key lifecycle and RBAC changes. linda you coordinate pager escalation.

mira (eng-security): confirming: before any signing we need COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE=true off? also we want attestations to include SBOM hash. add to pipeline: `cosign sign-blob --attestations sbom.json`

deepak (eng-infra): deploy-bot: artifacts for base-v2 are pushed: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-v2/3891234567 (fetchable).

deploy-bot: build 3891234567/base-v2 pushed by evan, signed=false, tags=[staging-canary] :white_check_mark:

linda (oncall): OK blockers? we need the IAM change and key alias before we can sign. deepak can you ETA?

deepak (eng-infra): ETA 45m to provision key + apply IAM + rolebinding. will post when done.

ev an (eng-runtime): thanks. once key is up i'll do a single-canary deploy and share metrics. please keep this thread for updates only.

mira (eng-security): noted. i'll run a quick preflight checklist: vuln backport diff, attestations schema, SIEM webhook. will flag if anything missing.

linda (oncall): copy. setting a provisional window: start 11:15 PT.
